description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation class used as a filter field in reports within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to modify query builders based on selected education filters, retrieve entity aliases, and convert filter values to array representations.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees based on their education level in reports.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds conditions to the query builder based on the selected education filter.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in queries for this filter.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the internal filter value to an array with education ID and label.
